name: Content Review
purpose: One inbound ALEX workflow preserving existing automatic acceptance, routing exceptions and explicitly curated collections to human review, and running assessments without waiting for manual follow-up.

intake: additional sources explicitly requested by the user

proposed_defaults.source_order: Explicit user priority first; restore the independent SOUPS floor and allow Virus Bulletin and regular weekly work to progress. Within unprocessed curated archives, prioritize newer publication years and verified papers; use waiting age as a tie-breaker and prevent starvation. Preserve oldest-waiting order for otherwise equivalent regular-weekly candidates.
proposed_defaults.global_review_ready_target_applies_to: Candidates actually requiring human review; automatically accepted candidates do not consume the manual-review buffer.
proposed_defaults.buffer_thresholds_status: User-confirmed: strictly below 100 triggers replenishment to 250.

stages: discover or resume retained inventory, completing accessible source archives additively without waiting for human review
deduplicate within and across all inventories and the current public corpus
resolve source/access and verify actual resource type
reconcile metadata and identifiers; record unknown citations as null
run existing source-appropriate quality hard gates and schema dry run
route existing automatic accepts/rejections and isolate unresolved holds
assess continuing usefulness and prepare content-based relevance recommendations only after all mechanical gates pass for surviving manual-review candidates
seal batches of 1–20 cleared candidates independently of held discovery reservations
preparation.unavailable_or_inadequate_evidence: Hold for evidence; do not invent findings or silently count as reviewed.

preflight_contract.checks: Each required check must record status=passed, checked_at and substantive evidence.
preflight_contract.hold_location: Source manifest preflight_records or non-ready records; never part of the human buffer.

batch_admission.policy: Seal cleared candidates immediately in batches of 1–20; held peers do not delay admission.

durable_transaction: per-candidate decisions tied to reviewed content hashes
outbox jobs for accepted-candidate assessments and buffer replenishment
submission_handoff.edited_decision: Only the latest complete valid revision governs eligibility; preserve historical decisions and superseded checks.
submission_handoff.changed_content: Require reassessment for material changes to the reviewed content; do not reuse acceptance for a different content hash.
feedback: last successful worker run and actionable error

checks: fresh cross-source and public-corpus duplicate checks
existing taxonomy classification and uncertainty flags
schema compatibility and dry-run import validation
automatic_assessments_after_acceptance.source_or_quota_failures: Record failure and retry/backoff status; never silently substitute a low-quality assessment or publish incomplete work.
automatic_assessments_after_acceptance.post_acceptance_scope: Final/time-sensitive revalidation and changed-content checks; initial format/access/metadata/duplicate/quality/schema gates run before human review.

release.regular_automatic_intake: Continue through the existing automatic publication path only after required checks pass; do not add a universal human approval step.
release.explicitly_curated_collections: Preserve their existing controlled import, merge and deployment authorization requirements.
release.existing_regular_pipeline: Integrate status reporting and automatic assessments while preserving current automatic-acceptance and publication rules. Saving this proposal does not alter the live pipeline.

implementation_work_remaining: Run and record source-specific preflight checks; release only evidenced passes into manual review.
Restore five SOUPS batches and global250 after preflight; report current deficits honestly.
Continue final validation for existing accepted records; preserve release authorization and automatic route.
automation_capability_observed: Hourly linked cloud Content Review task verified read/write access; production D1 submission outbox persists work immediately for the next worker pass.

routing.automatic_acceptance: Regular inbound candidates meeting the existing source-appropriate scoring, relevance, evidence and quality rules continue through the automatic route. No universal manual content-review gate is added.
routing.manual_review: Borderline scores, ambiguous relevance or classification, conflicting metadata, possible duplicates, Other reclassification, and collections explicitly designated for human curation.
routing.explicit_collection_curation: SOUPS and Virus Bulletin retain their requested manual review batches unless the user changes that collection's mode. A global workflow name does not silently change collection-specific curation.
routing.rejection_and_holds: Keep existing low-score rejection/audit rules and distinguish retryable or unresolved evidence holds. Preserve rejection history.

clarification: 27 October 2026: the user explicitly clarified that high-quality, high-scoring entries should continue to be auto-accepted as previously done; Content Review is not universal manual review. On 27 October the user made human time the highest priority: all foreseeable mechanical disqualifiers must be checked before manual relevance review, globally.

buffer_policy.scope: Global across the active human-review queues.
buffer_policy.counted: Distinct, preflight-passed, substantively assessed and still-unreviewed candidates; every required mechanical check is evidence-backed and bound to current content hash, after overlaying complete console decisions.
excluded: records with unresolved mechanical quality or schema blockers
buffer_policy.action: Prepare and publish enough additional review-ready candidates to restore the current global count to 250.
buffer_policy.retry_policy: Checkpoint completed work and resume after transient failures or source limits until the target is reached, or explicitly report source exhaustion or a blocking failure.
buffer_policy.worker_integration: Enabled hourly Content Review cloud task, linked to review console. Immutable submission requests trigger assessment/refill work on the next worker pass; independent SOUPS reserve maintained.

material_usefulness_policy.presentation_without_verified_substantiv: Major resource-usefulness deduction; no automatic acceptance while audio is absent or unverified.
material_usefulness_policy.verified_full_recording: A matching substantive recording with usable audio improves inclusion value and removes the missing-audio deduction after verification.

rolling_backlog.new_weekly_arrivals: Refresh upstream review-tier inventory each run and ingest additively, preserving prior IDs/decisions; no duplicate reintroduction.
rolling_backlog.backlog_outside_active_buffer: Retain all discoveries in source inventory; promote only substantively assessed candidates into the active shared buffer.

background_worker.submission_requests: Production D1 review_jobs atomically queued with completed review submissions; drafts enqueue nothing.
background_worker.execution_latency: Requests persist immediately; scheduled processing checks at most hourly. No claim of instant execution.

human_effort_policy.priority: Human review time is the most valuable resource.
human_effort_policy.rule: Complete mechanical checks before asking for editorial relevance review. Targets never justify admitting unchecked candidates.
human_effort_policy.recheck_after_acceptance: Only changed/time-sensitive evidence and final publication validation; do not postpone foreseeable disqualifying checks until after manual review.

archive_discovery_policy.goal: Capture the complete accessible archive into a durable discovery inventory without waiting for manual review or completion of earlier mechanical checks.
discovery_contents: title, authors and year as observed
paper, slides and recording links with provisional types
annual and ancillary coverage gaps, request failures and retry/backoff state
archive_discovery_policy.deduplication: Reconcile overlapping main, ancillary and programme inventories and preserve distinct versions. Report unique identities and overlaps; never add raw counts as if disjoint.
archive_discovery_policy.execution: Resume discovery and mechanical processing in bounded checkpointed batches under the single-writer lease, request timeouts, source pacing and provider backoff. Discovery may progress while earlier candidates remain held.
archive_discovery_policy.processing_priority: Newer publication years and actual papers first within curated archives; presentations require separate resource/audio verification. Historical archive gaps remain recorded and are revisited without starving other sources.
archive_discovery_policy.before_new_work: Consult durable corpus exclusions, preserve authenticated decisions and prior content hashes.
archive_discovery_policy.admission: Raw discoveries remain outside the cleared manual buffer. Complete format, access, metadata, fresh duplicates, existing quality/hard gates and schema before substantive recommendations and admission.
archive_discovery_policy.counts: Report discovered, mechanically held, cleared awaiting admission and ready separately; never describe discovery coverage as validated eligible papers.

current_usefulness_policy.scope: All inbound sources and collections, including SOUPS, Virus Bulletin and regular weekly discovery.
current_usefulness_policy.assessment_timing: After all six mechanical preflight gates pass and before substantive recommendation binding/manual admission.
current_usefulness_policy.priority: Present-day usefulness to cybercrime research and investigation takes precedence over historical existence or accumulated citations.

labels.currently_useful: The method, evidence or insight remains applicable; explain its current use and limitations.
labels.foundational_historical: Retains demonstrable foundational or historical value; label that value explicitly and give it lower preparation priority.
labels.superseded: Depends on obsolete conditions and offers little transferable value; recommend exclusion with a concrete content-based reason.

evidence_required: material actually inspected and assessment depth
specific present-day application or historical contribution
obsolete assumptions, dependencies or superseding evidence when applicable
current_usefulness_policy.older_material: Require a stronger explicit explanation of continuing usefulness for older material; distinguish obsolete platform-specific techniques from transferable methods, behavioural findings and investigative principles.
current_usefulness_policy.unknown: If usefulness or supersession cannot be established, record uncertainty and discuss or hold as appropriate; do not infer obsolescence from publication year.
current_usefulness_policy.preserve: Existing scores, hard gates, automatic acceptance, prior decisions and reviewed-content hashes remain in force. No retroactive removal or decision reversal without the existing authenticated decision process.
current_usefulness_policy.implementation_scope: Recorded worker/editorial instructions. No new numerical age penalty, score weight or public UI badge is claimed as implemented.
